newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Mr Chips says margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Mr Chips says margins under pressure.

text.p: Food manufacturer Mr Chips Holding Ltd said on Thursday its annual result was affected by margin pressures and dumping by a competitor.
It reported a flat March year profit of NZ$920,000 as a result of ongoing difficult trading conditions and a marked reduction in exports partly due to the high value of the kiwi dollar.
Competitive pressure on the domestic market was affected by a major competitor selling large quantities of excess stocks, from previous years manufacture, of varying quality below cost.
"However, this dumping and another major processor aggressively seeking market share placed considerable pressure on pricing and has led to widespread discounting.
"Margins remain under pressure despite an ongoing efficiency program and reduced packaging costs."
Mr Chips said it had experienced another difficult year with base profitability intact.
"This is an excellent platform for growth when market conditions for both domestic and export markets improve," it said. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
